name: estoque-agrogest
description: Sistema web de gestão e controle de estoque integrado ao CRM Agrogest

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @estoque/api && npm run build -w @estoque/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @estoque/shared" "npm run dev -w @estoque/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @estoque/api" "npm run dev -w @estoque/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
